provenance.origin: Anonymized upstream CUKTECH protocol regression samples derived from real BLE notifications; not synthetic.
provenance.privacy: No device identifiers, credentials, capture filenames, record indices or absolute timestamps. Relative timing and protocol payloads are retained for regression coverage.
provenance.frame_definition: ATT Handle Value Notification value bytes, including the 4-byte CUKTECH frame header; no HCI/L2CAP framing.
provenance.plaintext_note: Session keys, tokens and authentication handshake data are not distributed. plaintext_hex is decoded protocol data.
provenance.replay_note: Stub decrypt to return plaintext_hex, or feed plaintext_hex into the production decoder. No real device credentials are required.
